question: Who won the gold in the Men's Singles SL3 at the 2025 Asia Para Badminton Championship?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nitesh Kumar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Indian para-shuttler **Nitesh Kumar** secured the **gold medal** in the **Men's Singles SL3** category at the **2025 Asia Para Badminton Championship**.
 
• His victory continues his dominant form in the international circuit, following his historic achievement at the **Paris 2024 Paralympics** where he also won **gold**.
 
• The **SL3** classification is designated for players who have impairment in one or both lower limbs and poor walking or running balance, requiring immense core strength and tactical placement.
 
• In the final match of the **2025** tournament, **Nitesh Kumar** displayed exceptional court coverage and resilience to overcome his opponent, further solidifying **India's** position as a powerhouse in para-badminton.
